- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated £2.7k revenue TW, the highest performing product by sales value across the portfolio.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS achieved £2.3k revenue TW and led order volume with 53 orders, indicating strong customer demand.
- PINK BLUE FELT CRAFT TRINKET BOX sold 1,515 units TW, the highest unit volume of any product this week.
- PAPER LANTERN 9 POINT DELUXE STAR showed exceptional growth with revenue up 1,841% WoW, the strongest week-over-week performance.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER demonstrated dual strength with £1.9k revenue TW and 275.8% revenue growth WoW.
- FELTCRAFT DOLL MOLLY surged 934.6% YoY in revenue while maintaining 888 units sold TW, indicating significant year-on-year expansion.
- FELTCRAFT BUTTERFLY HEARTS grew 573.2% YoY with 1,072 units sold TW, showing strong momentum in the felt craft category.
- RED WOOLLY HOTTIE WHITE HEART achieved 388.8% revenue growth WoW, demonstrating rapid acceleration in customer purchases this week.
